tax.text: He says his campaign seeks less government and criticizes the two major parties for failing to control government spending and taxes.
tax.quote: My campaign is about less government and more freedom.

wages.text: He supports less government intrusion into business decisions about hiring, benefits and compensation.
wages.quote: This also means less government intrusion into business operations such as decisions regarding hiring, benefits and compensation.

trade.text: Parsons proposes eliminating trade tariffs, which he says raise costs and reduce jobs.
trade.quote: Eliminate trade tariffs (the 2018 trade war with China alone costs America $50 billion a year and 166,000 jobs)

cannabis.text: He says government should intrude less into personal decisions about marijuana use.
cannabis.quote: This means less government intrusion into personal decisions such as whether one uses a seat belt or smokes marijuana.

wages.text: Green says she supports raising the minimum wage.
wages.quote: Raising the minimum wage so work actually pays.

schools.text: Green says Arkansas needs excellent public schools as part of strong infrastructure.

immigration.text: Green says immigration policies that make it harder for foreign medical professionals to practice in the United States are a concern.
immigration.quote: She's also concerned about immigration policies making it harder for foreign medical professionals to practice in the U.S.

health.text: Called for accessible, affordable health care and opposed cuts to Medicare and Medicaid funding.
health.quote: Accessible, affordable healthcare so getting sick does not mean going broke

immigration.text: He voted for legislation described as defending the southern border after the expiration of Title 42.
immigration.quote: Rep. Crawford Votes to Defend our Southern Border as Title 42 Lapse Causes Chaos

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He introduced legislation requiring federal prisons to house inmates according to their biological sex.
gender.quote: The legislation would require the Bureau of Prisons to house federal inmates according to their biological sex

health.text: He advocates market-based health care with more consumer choice, expanded savings accounts, and insurance sales across state lines.
health.quote: I favor patient-centered health care that allows individuals the freedom to make important health related decisions.
